description: Accepts one buyer's offer on the caller's own listing on XP -- 'accept the $200 offer on my tickets'. The offer comes from a buyer, not from XP. Accepting is a sale and cannot be undone: the seller then transfers the tickets through XP to that buyer by a deadline XP sets at acceptance, and missing it can cancel the sale and forfeit the payout. The deadline is per sale, not a fixed window; the result carries it, or says XP has not set it yet. confirm=false returns a preview of the offer; confirm=true accepts it, and only that call returns success=true. identifier and offer_uuid come from get_my_listing_status. Requires sign-in and the write:listings scope.

confirm.description: Required. True to accept the offer; False to preview without accepting.

identifier.description: Public listing identifier from list_my_listings or get_my_listing_status.

name: accept_offer
title: Accept Offer
